Definition: Water at one height all around a terrain, reaching out to the horizon. The ground hides it wherever the ground is higher.
The height of the sea's surface. Ground below it is under water, and ground above it is dry land.
The line where the ground rises out of the water.
How much a color hides what is behind it, from 0 (hides nothing) to 1 (hides everything).
How quickly the water gets darker and hides the ground as it gets deeper. 0 is perfectly clear.
A small wave on the water's surface. Ripples bend the light, so the water sparkles and shimmers.
Light that bounces off the water's surface, so the water shows the sky.
A small program the graphics card runs to work out the color of every point on the screen.
